name: Auto build 350a3fc1fa5a87d5232193479b25d3f22bd1845d
body:
Auto-built from commit `350a3fc1fa5a87d5232193479b25d3f22bd1845d`.

Commit message: msadmin: match Node server.js ingest/auth behavior byte-for-byte

- EXPECTED_FIELDS is the real 10-field client schema (machine_id, os, cpu,
  cpu_cores, gpu, ram_mb, display, game_version, uptime_sec, crash_text)
  instead of the 25 invented fields that rejected every real payload
- all ingest errors are now JSON {"ok":false,"error":"..."} with Node's exact
  strings (bad json / expected object / empty body / missing field X / bad
  field X / rate limited / payload too large / server error)
- success is {"ok":true} with no id
- crash_text coerced to null (non-string non-null); int fields use
  Number.isInteger semantics; blob JSON stringify sorts keys and renders
  integral floats as integers (4.0 -> 4)
- login: locked-out attempts return 423 with 'Too many failed attempts.
  Retry in ~Ns.'; failures recorded by handler (matches store.js)
- revoke-all requires a session and clears the cookie; logout always clears
- unsupported methods (incl. HEAD) return 501 'Unsupported method'
- query strings stripped from the route path like Node's split('?')[0]
- viewer/HTML replicated from Node server.js (escapeHtml uses ');
  recent rows ordered by id DESC, stats use ts >= cutoff
- e2e now asserts exact bodies for every ingest error, 423 lockout and 501
